purpose: Side bucket for P6B items that could not be implemented safely. Items here are NOT certified and stay fail-closed (not installable / not executable). Rendered to docs/audits/vehicles/p6b-deferred-work.md by tools/audits/vehicles/build-p6b-deferred-work.mjs.

items.reason: Hit points increase by a percentage; the book gives no rounding rule, and it is unruled whether the percentage applies to printed HP only or also to other HP increases.
options: percentage of printed HP only vs current maximum
items.impact: 3 rows stay SOURCE_VERIFIED and not installable.
items.recommendedAction: Owner rules on V-P6-01; the effect is a one-line hp kind in the effects registry once ruled.

items.source: Starships of the Galaxy p. 41, Table 3-3
items.reason: Every published hull already has a sublight speed; installing a drive is a replacement, which is unruled (same question as shields/hyperdrives). The 'military vessels only' clause for the fastest drives has no hull 'military' attribute in canonical data.
items.missing: Replacement rule (refund, EP of the old drive); a source-backed military-hull classification.
options: replacement frees the old drive's EP
replacement keeps the old EP consumed
replacement not allowed on stock hulls
items.impact: 6 rows stay SOURCE_VERIFIED and not installable; starship-scale speed is never changed by the Shipyard.
items.recommendedAction: Owner rules on V-P6-02; then decide how a hull is classified as military (data field) before enabling the fastest drives.

items.reason: The rule is printed clearly, but applying it needs an effect on ANOTHER vehicle: a swift action that picks a target within 6 starship squares, a per-target size-based penalty on Use Computer (communications/sensors) and on fire control (not reducing the Intelligence modifier below +0), and an opposed Use Computer check. None of these consumers exists: no starship-scale range measurement, no cross-actor temporary condition store, and fire control is not used by any executable weapon (V-P2-04).
items.missing: Cross-vehicle temporary effect state, starship-scale range check, opposed-check flow, fire-control penalty consumer.
items.impact: 2 rows stay SOURCE_VERIFIED and not installable.
items.recommendedAction: Build after weapon execution (V-P2-04) exists, using the combat ActiveEffect path for the target condition.

items.reason: Effects are 'treated as one size smaller when targeted by capital-ship weapons' and 'treated as a starfighter for dogfighting and starship combat maneuvers'. The system has no dogfight eligibility check, no starship-maneuver eligibility by size, and no executable capital-ship weapon targeting.
items.missing: Dogfight / starship maneuver eligibility consumer; capital-weapon targeting (blocked by V-P2-04).
items.impact: Row stays SOURCE_VERIFIED and not installable.
items.recommendedAction: Implement as a size-category override read by the dogfight and capital-weapon targeting code once those exist.

items.reason: The printed text says only that it stores two jumps' worth of information. It does not state whether it grants the navicomputer's +5 astrogation bonus, or what happens on a third jump.
items.missing: Bonus value (if any) and the consequence of exceeding two stored jumps.
options: no astrogation bonus; storage limit only
same +5 as a standard navicomputer while within its two stored jumps
items.impact: Row stays SOURCE_VERIFIED and not installable.

items.reason: The +5 bonus is integrated. Any trained-only gate for astrogation in the skill roller is not vehicle-aware, so a navicomputer clause about untrained astrogation has no consumer; the roll is never blocked by the vehicle code either way.
items.missing: A trained-only check consumer for Use Computer (astrogate) that can see the vehicle.
items.impact: No incorrect mechanic: the bonus applies; the training permission is not enforced either way.
items.recommendedAction: Wire when the skill roller gains trained-only enforcement for skill uses.

items.reason: The row's effect text is legacy and unverified; the census does not match it to a printed SotG row.
items.missing: A printed source for the component and its effect.
items.recommendedAction: Locate a printed source or retire the legacy row.

items.reason: Verified offline (Node tests with Handlebars). Foundry V13 runtime is not available in this environment.
items.missing: Live V13 session run of docs/audits/vehicles/p6a-final-acceptance-report.md checklist plus P6B-1 items (recharge shields restores 10 with regenerating shields; SLAM bonus in speed Pilot check; astrogation roll bonus).

items.reason: Installed and certified: the effective Intelligence score and modifier are computed and shown. No runtime consumer reads a vehicle's Intelligence yet (vehicle weapon attack rolls are disabled under V-P2-04; printed crew skill modifiers are not recomputed from Intelligence).
items.missing: A vehicle attack-roll consumer (fire control) and a source-backed rule for which checks use the vehicle Intelligence modifier.
items.impact: Ledger status EXPOSED_NOT_APPLIED (mechanicallyApplied false) while installable.
items.recommendedAction: Read getEffectiveVehicleDerived().intelligence in P6B-3 weapon attack resolution once V-P2-04 is resolved.

options: convert to days (week 7, month 30, year 365) then round down
round in the printed unit, minimum 1 day
items.component: cargo pods / extended range / smuggler compartments on hulls whose printed unit needs conversion
items.reason: Cargo pods add tons; 181 hulls print cargo in kg (and some in annotated units). Extended range adds 10% rounded down with a 1-day minimum; 279 hulls print consumables in weeks/months/years, and rounding in days or in the printed unit gives different results. Smuggler compartments cap hidden cargo at 5% of original cargo, again in kg vs tons.
items.missing: Whether 1 ton = 1,000 kg for cargo arithmetic; which unit the extended-range rounding uses and the day length of a month/year.
items.impact: Fail-closed: planner refuses with CARGO_UNIT_NOT_TONS / CONSUMABLES_UNIT_CONVERSION_UNRULED; smuggler compartments not installable.
items.recommendedAction: Owner rules on V-P6B-02; then the refusals become conversions.

items.reason: The catalog size restriction (Colossal or larger / Colossal (frigate) or larger) disagrees with the paraphrased prose (frigate or larger / cruiser or larger), and the per-bay lifeboat count (cost modifier/50, /100) is fractional for the smaller sizes the catalog allows.
items.missing: PDF confirmation of the size restriction and the per-bay count.
items.recommendedAction: Confirm against the PDF; then a capacity effect like hangar bays.

items.reason: The catalog paraphrase computes capacity from the ship's "size modifier" (a negative number for starships), which cannot be a passenger count; the printed basis is likely the cost modifier but this was not confirmed.
items.missing: PDF wording of the capacity basis.
items.recommendedAction: Confirm against the PDF and correct the paraphrase; then a capacity effect.

options: round down the reduction (crew rounds up)
items.reason: Crew requirement is reduced by 1/3 or 2/3 (never below 1); the rounding of fractional crew is not stated. Recall circuits also need a summon action and an untrained-crew override with no consumer.
items.missing: Rounding rule for crew reduction; recall action consumer.

items.reason: Automatic deployment when the ship moves down the condition track, a +13 Mechanics jury-rig of 1 step, and a 25% destruction chance when damage exceeds SR. This automates condition-track and damage application (runtime-risky) and depends on the Core jury-rig DC and duration, which the accessory text does not restate.
items.missing: Condition-track change hook for vehicles with a safe automation path; Core jury-rig DC/duration reference.
items.recommendedAction: Implement as a GM-prompted (not automatic) roll first, after live testing of vehicle condition track.

items.component: cargo-jettison, transponders (IFF, masked, disguised x3), cloaking (hibridium, stygium), docking clamps, holonet/hyper transceivers, luxury upgrades
items.reason: Action or narrative components with no consumer: no cargo-bay inventory to jettison; no sensor identification/IFF model; no concealment/Stealth consumer for starship combat; no docking state; communications are narrative; luxury maintenance and crew-quality step changes would require recomputing printed statblocks. Masked/disguised transponders also have special installation-failure outcomes (sublight engines destroyed) not modeled by the installation job.
items.missing: Consumers listed; installation-failure side effects for transponders.
items.impact: Not installable; shown as reference only.
items.recommendedAction: Revisit per component when the consuming system exists; transceivers could be enabled as narrative capabilities if the owner wants installable non-mechanical components.
